note: Index only. Terms live in the student-ai-tools notes. This file does not restate price tables or carry referral links.

items.name: Notion
items.summary: Plus free for eligible students and educators, one-member workspace. Claim with a school email.

items.name: GitHub Student Developer Pack
items.summary: The gold-standard student bundle, including Copilot access for verified students.

items.name: AWS Educate
items.summary: Free self-paced cloud training and hands-on labs, with digital badges.

items.name: Google Gemini
items.summary: Google's general AI assistant, bundled with Gmail, Docs and a storage bump.

items.name: Granola
items.summary: AI notepad for meetings and lectures. The page labels this a limited edition.

items.name: Figma
items.summary: Full Professional plan for verified higher-ed students.

items.name: Zed
items.summary: A remaining free route to a premium AI editor after Cursor's student discount closed.

items.name: Beautiful.ai
items.summary: AI slide-deck builder. Verify a .edu email; they send a coupon code.

items.name: Framer
items.summary: Design-to-web tool with a free student plan that includes monthly AI credits.

items.name: Microsoft 365 Personal
items.summary: Half price on the consumer Personal plan. Separate from any campus Education licence.

items.name: Perplexity
items.summary: Education Pro at half the regular Pro rate. Verify through SheerID.

items.name: OpenAI Codex
items.summary: Credits for Codex only — not a ChatGPT Plus discount and not general API credit. Confirm the current grant on the official page.

items.name: Adobe Creative Cloud
items.summary: Steep first-year student rate, then a higher renewal. Confirm the figure on Adobe's education store.

items.name: Grammarly
items.summary: A seasonal SheerID campaign, not a standing offer. Check it is live before relying on it.

items.name: Otter.ai
items.summary: Individual Pro only. Official help-centre path — no referral link here.

items.name: QuillBot
items.summary: Tiered by billing cycle through Student Beans or UNiDAYS.

items.name: Obsidian
items.summary: The app itself is free. The discount is on the two paid add-ons.

items.name: Loom
items.summary: Up to 50% off for general academic use, 75% for classroom use. Confirm on the Atlassian page.

items.name: Amp
items.summary: Self-declaration. Announced the day it was first recorded. Re-check before relying on it.

items.name: Reclaim.ai
items.summary: AI calendar. Low eligibility bar; confirm the current window on the official page.

items.name: Speechify
items.summary: UNiDAYS route. Confirm the campaign is live.

items.name: Aqua Voice
items.summary: Steep percentage discount. Smaller and less proven than Wispr Flow.

items.name: Microsoft Azure for Students
items.summary: Azure credit to use within 12 months, with no credit card required. Confirm the current grant on the official page.

items.name: Google Cloud for Students
items.summary: Learning credit for labs and badges, not deployment credit.

items.name: Wispr Flow
items.summary: Proof of enrolment is required. Official students page only — no referral link here.

items.name: Cursor
items.summary: New sign-ups for the legacy student discount closed 2026-06-25.

items.name: Coda (now Superhuman Docs)
items.summary: Paused for new applications as of 2026-06-30.

items.name: Tabnine
items.summary: Ended its free Basic plan in April 2025 and no longer offers a student plan.
